sentences.en: Something hit her and sent her sprawling to the ground.
sentences.zh: 她突然被什么东西撞到，整个人摔到了地上。

sentences.en: He sprawled out on the sofa next to me.
sentences.zh: 他懒洋洋地躺在沙发边上。

sentences.en: She found her sister sprawled unconscious on the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 她发现妹妹倒在人行道上不省人事。

senses.zh: 蔓生；伸开手足躺卧姿势
蔓延；伸开手足躺；无计划地扩展

mnemonic: 联想记忆：伸展手脚趴在地上（sprawl）潦草地写（scrawl）
